item.subject: science
item.stem: In a village field in Punjab, Meena watches cattle egrets walking beside grazing buffaloes. The egrets eat insects that the buffaloes disturb, so the egrets get food easily, while the buffaloes are neither helped nor harmed. Which type of relationship is this?

options.A: mutualism, because both the egret and the buffalo benefit
options.B: commensalism, because the egret benefits and the buffalo is unaffected
options.C: parasitism, because the egret benefits and the buffalo is harmed
options.D: competition, because the egret and the buffalo share the same food
